'''Dorovio Bold''' was a light-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="SWCVD" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="DB" /> with [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Hasbro" /> She<ref name="DB" /> joined an [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] and was a top [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]].<ref name="SWCVD" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used their [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] to [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroy]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Bold joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after learning about that action, becoming a [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]]<ref name="SWCVD" /> and joining the Alliance's [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]].<ref name="DB" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Alliance [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] attacked the Imperial [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="NEC" /> Bold flew a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] in the battle, where she fought Imperial starfighters.<ref name="Hasbro" /> The battle ended with an Alliance victory and the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] destruction.<ref name="NEC" /> Bold wore an orange [[Rebel flight suit]] and a [[Flight helmet/Legends|flight helmet]], and she was armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I've lost my main stabilizer! I can't pull out!|Lines from Vivienne Chandler's unused scene|<ref name="Making">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>}}
Dorovio Bold was set to appear in [[1983]]'s [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], portrayed by actress [[Vivienne Chandler]], but her scene was deleted.<ref name="Making" /> The [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was filmed at [[Elstree Studios]] between [[March]] and [[April]] of [[1982]].<ref name="Aficionado">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2011/09/girl-power-jedis-female-fighter-pilots.html|name=Star Wars Aficionado|text=Girl Power! "Jedi"s Female Fighter Pilots...}}</ref> In [[2006]], she was first mentioned outside of the deleted scene in ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]], [[James Luceno]], and [[Ryder Windham]].<ref name="SWCVD" />

In [[2013]], the digital edition of ''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]'' released footage of Bold's scene, where the Rebel pilot suffered critical damage to her T-65 [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter's]] [[Stabilizer/Legends|stabilizers]] during the Battle of Endor.<ref name="Making" /> The design of Bold's [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] was first used as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] native [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Blast shield/Legends|blast shield]] helmet in [[1977]]'s original trilogy film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="Costumes">''[[Star Wars Costumes: The Original Trilogy]]''</ref> [[1995]]'s [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire]]'' used film props in the game's filming,<ref name="LAV">{{LucasArts|url=products/rebel2/reb_vid.htm|text=''Rebel Assault II'' - Live Action Video}}</ref> with Rebel pilot [[Darnell Reggs]] being depicted with a helmet of the same design.<ref name="RAII">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire]]''</ref> The helmet prop went on to be stored at ''[[Star Wars Identities: The Exhibition]]''.<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|150|Launchpad|Launch Pad}}</ref>
